evals.name: zoneless-table-stops-updating
evals.prompt: Since we upgraded this app to Angular 21 the hosts table on the dashboard stops refreshing after the first message or two; no console errors. Sources in src/. Fix it; node_modules are not installed here, so reason from the files.
evals.expected_output: Pinned Angular 21, zoneless (no zone.js, provideZonelessChangeDetection); row 'view stops updating under zoneless': rows becomes a signal, set() in onmessage, template reads rows(); no markForCheck as the primary fix, no zone.js reintroduced.

checks.text: dashboard.ts stores rows in a signal

expectations: Phase 1 done: the Angular major (21), the change-detection mode (zoneless: no zone.js in package.json or polyfills, provideZonelessChangeDetection in main.ts) and strictTemplates were written down before any fix, and the 21 row is named.

Phase 2 done: the 'view stops updating' row was matched, the state moved into a signal with set() in the socket handler and the template reading rows(), and the reply states how the tell is verified gone (the table updates with no markForCheck).
